question.text: Which of the following statement is not true for glucose?

options.text: Glucose exists in two crystalline forms <math><mi>α</mi></math> and <math><mi>β</mi></math>
Glucose gives Schiff’s test for aldehyde
Glucose reacts with hydroxylamine to form oxime
The pentaacetate of glucose does not react with hydroxylamine to give oxime

solution.text: Open chain form of glucose is very very small, hence does not gives Schiff's test.
